content.text:
I couldn't check your data this morning. Garmin is limiting requests right now and has asked me to wait about 15 minutes before trying again, so I've stopped for now. It's a temporary block on Garmin's end, not a problem with your account or watch.

**What to do:**
- **Ask me again in 15 minutes or more.** I'll get today's status, including how you slept, your heart rate variability (HRV) and resting heart rate compared with your 7-day averages, your training readiness, your recent training load and any workouts planned for today.
- **Or check your watch or the Garmin Connect app.** Training Readiness and Morning Report show the main numbers right away.

If you have a workout or race planned today, tell me when you ask again and I'll focus on whether you're ready for it.
